## WORK EXPERIENCE

Software Engineer (The DevTime Tech.) March 2022 – Aug 2026

multi-user collaborative editing for 500+ users.
    • Delivered many high-quality features across React.js, Next.js projects with Redux & Context API state
management in applications and contributed to consistent client satisfaction.

influence campaigns generation & Integrated LinkedIn Posts and Authentication APIs also added
websocket for Realtime data.

PDF highlights, commenting, and import/export that resulted in a boosting reviewer efficiency by
40%.
    • Developed realtime generative AI chat like ChatGPT with edit, regenerate, chat history, folder and
favorites functionality.
